settings.title: Retention, privacy & rights
settings.page_intro: Module policies, internal alert recipients and board stages.
settings.forbidden: recruitment.manage is required to edit settings.
settings.section_capture_desc: How outcomes are communicated and how imports work.
settings.section_privacy_desc: GDPR deadlines and links candidates see.
settings.section_notifications_desc: Who gets reminders when a rights request approaches its deadline.
settings.privacy_url_legal_center: Candidate privacy is managed in Legal Center (privacy_candidates). Public job postings read that source.
settings.ai_dpa_legal_hint: You can also review the commercial DPA under Settings → Legal (dpa_platform).
settings.rejection_notify_hint: Batch-on-archive needs the candidate preferences portal URL.
settings.candidate_portal_base_url_hint: Used in rejection/archive emails (preferences link). Not the apply URL. If empty, the platform public portal URL may be used.
settings.rights_sla_notify_emails_hint: Empty = tenant owners/managers. Search members or add an external email.
settings.sla_search_members: Search members by name or email…
settings.import_legal_basis_hint: Included in the Art. 14 notice sent to imported candidates.
settings.legal_basis_note_required: A note is required when legal basis is “Other”.
settings.analytics_min_cohort_hint: Aggregates with fewer applications than this are hidden (3–20). Default 5.
settings.inbound_enabled_hint: Allows the Resend Inbound webhook to process mail for this tenant. Platform setup required (see REC-7 runbook).
settings.inbound_address_hint_desc: E.g. jobs@company.com — documentary / best-effort match; does not configure MX.
settings.ai_intro: Optional assistance to structure CVs. Hire/reject decisions remain human (Art. 22).
settings.ai_dpa: I confirm an adequate DPA is in place with the tenant LLM provider.
settings.ai_transfer: I accept that BYOK providers may involve international transfers / SCCs outside the EU or without adequacy.
settings.ai_sensitive_hint: CVs may contain sensitive data. Only extracted text is sent (not photos or binaries).
settings.ai_checklist_required: Both DPA and transfer must be checked.
settings.ai_need_config: Configure and verify an AI key under Settings → AI.
settings.ai_need_checklist: Accept the DPA and transfer checklist first.
settings.ai_art22: AI is assistive only; it does not make automated selection decisions.

stages.title: Pipeline stages (tenant defaults)
stages.hint: Applied to all postings without their own override.
stages.hub_intro: These stages feed the Applications board. Each posting can override them.
stages.name: Name
stages.delete_confirm: Stage “{{name}}” will be deleted. Applications on this stage will become unstaged.
stages.posting_hint: Optional: clone tenant stages to customise them for this posting only.
stages.using_tenant_defaults: This posting uses the tenant default stages.
stages.reset_confirm: This deletes posting-specific stages and clears application stage links.

kanban.move_override_mismatch: This posting has custom stages with no match; open it to move the candidate.

drawer.title: Application
drawer.name: Name
drawer.terminal_note: Terminal stage ≠ communicated outcome: the candidate still sees an open process until you communicate the result.
drawer.outcome_done: Outcome already communicated; the candidate sees a closed process.
drawer.communicate_confirm_body: A rejection email (if template exists) with a preferences link will be sent and the candidate portal will show closed. Stage does not change.
drawer.communicate_no_portal_url: Missing VITE_PUBLIC_PORTAL_BASE_URL: the email may omit the preferences link.
drawer.hire_confirm_body: An ELM employee (onboarding) will be created, the candidate portal closed, and a next-steps email sent. This is not just moving the Kanban stage.
drawer.structure_cv_art22: Assistive proposal: review and confirm before saving. Hire/reject remains human.
drawer.structure_cv_needs_review: This CV has no text layer (scanned PDF or image). Human review only; OCR comes later.
drawer.structure_cv_not_pdf: Only digital PDF CVs can be structured.
drawer.structure_json_hint: Edit the proposal JSON before confirming.

export.title: Export applications
export.warning: The CSV file leaves PiMed retention control. The tenant is responsible for destroying it when required (GDPR).
export.ack_label: I understand the warning and accept responsibility for the exported file.
export.success_with_excluded: Exported {{count}} rows (TTL 15 min). Excluded by Art. 18/21: {{excluded}}.

rights.title: GDPR rights inbox
rights.intro: Access, rectification, erasure, restriction, portability and objection requests (Art. 15–21). Full export is emailed; it is not downloaded in the browser.
rights.forbidden: recruitment.rights permission is required to manage this inbox.
rights.approve_access_body: An email with the Art. 15 export link will be sent. The JSON is not downloaded here.
rights.approve_erasure_body: The requester's applications in this tenant will be erased (Art. 17) and they will be notified.
rights.approve_rectification_body: You can update the applicant's name and phone and/or add notes. The requester will be notified.
rights.approve_restriction_body: Processing restriction (Art. 18) will be flagged. Hire/communicate/stage moves will be blocked.
rights.approve_portability_body: Same as access: export by email (Art. 20), without downloading JSON here.
rights.approve_objection_body: Objection (Art. 21) will be recorded, talent pool cleared. Notes required. Hire/communicate/stage moves will be blocked.
rights.reject_body: A reason is required. It will be emailed to the requester.
rights.notes_required: Notes and/or data changes are required for this type.
